title: unified-rollouts-add-autorollback-workflow-for-canary-ab-shadow
author: Sofia Martinez
description:
Motivation:
We need a unified, observable autorollback workflow that covers canary, A/B and shadow deployments. Current rollout automation handles weighted canaries but lacks a single workflow that coordinates metric collection, quorum decisions, quarantine/probing stages, and safe automated rollback across shadow and A/B traffic. This PR introduces a coordinated autorollback workflow, improves observability hooks used by the decision engine, and adds end-to-end tests to reduce flakiness seen during incidents.

What this changes:
- Add a new rollout workflow controller (rollout/workflow/controller.go) that implements a state machine for staged deployments (probe -> canary -> ramp -> monitor -> commit/rollback).
- Introduce a policy format (rollout/policies/autorollback.yaml) to declare multi-metric thresholds, quorum rules, and quarantine stages for probing.
- Extend the metric adapter (observability/metrics.go) with windowed aggregations and alerting hooks used by the rollout controller.
- Add a shadow-probing coordinator (rollout/shadow_coordinator.go) that can run probes in shadow traffic and return composite decisions to the controller.
- Add e2e tests (tests/rollout_e2e_test.go) that simulate traffic patterns and inject metric regressions to validate rollback triggers and quarantine behaviour.
- Update docs and rollout examples (docs/rollouts.md) and add a migration note for existing weighted canary configs.

Implementation notes:
- The controller exposes a single reconciliation loop and relies on the metric adapter to compute aggregate deltas and confidence intervals. Decisions are computed using the new composite-metric quorum: a majority of configured metrics must exceed thresholds (or explicit veto metrics can force rollback).
- Quarantine stage: when metrics are borderline, the controller will place the rollout into a quarantined probing state where it lowers traffic and runs targeted probes. If probes pass, rollout resumes; if not, it auto-rolls back.
- Shadow probing: the coordinator can run the same probes using shadowed requests and compare outputs via a lightweight reranker to detect quality regressions without impacting real users.
- Safety guards: max rollback rate, a cooldown window before re-attempting same model, and a feature flag (rollouts.autorollback.enable) for gradual rollout to production.

Risks and mitigations:
- Flaky e2e: added stabilization hooks (deterministic seeds, mock metrics backends) and run in CI with higher timeouts.
- Performance: controller uses batching and backoff; added benchmarks to ensure the controller loop adds negligible CPU for typical cluster sizes.

Notes on compatibility:
- Existing weighted canary configs continue to work. New policy format uses a backwards-compatible key (policy.v2) and migration script in tools/migrate_rollout_policies.go.

Related tickets: ENG-2478 (autorollback design), ENG-2483 (observability metrics for rollouts), SUP-9123 (customer incident that motivated quorum logic).

review_comments: Arjun Patel: Please clarify the quorum semantics — is it strict majority or weighted? Also add a unit test for the veto metric path.
Sofia Martinez: Quorum is weighted by metric importance (policy field 'weight'). Added unit tests covering veto and weighted quorum in rollout/engine_test.go.
Lena Korhonen: Observability changes look good but add an env var to control aggregation window for low-traffic customers.
Sofia Martinez: Added ROLLUP_METRIC_WINDOW env override and documented it in docs/rollouts.md. Kept default to 1m for stability.
Marcus Chen: e2e looks flaky on the first run (timeout in test 'rollback-on-latency-regression'), re-run CI after extending timeouts.
CI Bot: re-run triggered by Marcus Chen
CI Bot: integration tests passed on re-run; e2e still flaky but passes in CI-extended; added retry logic to unstable test
ci_checks: benchmarks: warnings (controller loop micro-benchmarks show 8% increase under synthetic load)
merge_outcome: Merged after approvals from Arjun Patel and Lena Korhonen. Squash-merged to main. Post-merge rollout feature flag defaulted to off; will be enabled gradually via infra toggle.
release_notes: Introduce autorollback workflow for unified rollouts: supports canary, A/B and shadow probing with quarantine stages, composite-metric quorum, and observability hooks. Backwards-compatible policy migration included. Feature gated behind rollouts.autorollback.enable.
notes_for_oncall: If a customer reports unexpected rollbacks after enabling autorollback, check rollout.controller decision logs and metric adapter windowing. Feature is behind flag; operations can set rollouts.autorollback.enable=false to globally disable. Monitor rollout.rollback.* metrics and alerts added in observability dashboard (rollouts/autorollback).
